name: competitor-release-tracker
description: Track competitor AI coding skill releases in parallel, verify findings independently, and gate human approval before updating the tracking database
diagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
  Plan[plan-tracking] --> TC[track-cursor-skills]
  Plan --> TClaude[track-claude-code-skills]
  Plan --> TCodex[track-codex-skills]
  TC --> RevReal[review-realness]
  TClaude --> RevReal
  TCodex --> RevReal
  TC --> RevFresh[review-freshness]
  TClaude --> RevFresh
  TCodex --> RevFresh
  RevReal --> Syn[synthesize-tracking]
  RevFresh --> Syn
  RevReal -.->|failure| TC
  RevReal -.->|failure| TClaude
  RevReal -.->|failure| TCodex
  Syn --> Gate[human-gate-update-db]
```

nodes.responsibility: Define which competitors to track and what release signals to monitor
Track new Cursor skill releases and changelog updates from the last 7 days
Track new Claude Code skill releases and marketplace additions from the last 7 days
Track new Codex skill releases and plugin updates from the last 7 days
Check whether every tracked release is a real, verifiable release and not a hallucinated entry
review_questions: Is every tracked competitor release a real, verifiable release with a public URL or changelog entry?

nodes.responsibility: Check whether all tracked releases are from the last 7 days and not stale entries
review_questions: Are all tracked releases dated within the last 7 days and not duplicates of older entries?

nodes.responsibility: Merge verified tracking data into a single competitor intelligence update
Human reviews the competitor intelligence update before writing to the tracking database

Reviewer needs all tracking outputs to check release dates
